Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager

Class DatabaseManager.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager.DatabaseManager.Builder
Enclosing class:
DatabaseManager
public static final class DatabaseManager.Builder extends Object
Collects what a DatabaseManager needs and checks it before the first use.

A builder is not thread-safe.

    • dataSource

      public DatabaseManager.Builder dataSource(String name, Supplier<? extends DataSource> supplier)
      Supplies the data source of one connection, such as a pooled one, instead of the one the connector would build from the config.

      The supplier runs once per build, under that connection's own lock. When the data source is AutoCloseable the manager closes it after the connector, on purge, disconnect and close.

      Parameters:
      name - a configured connection name, never null
      supplier - creates the data source, never null; must not return null
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a supplier is already registered for the name
